answer: Delayed-Seed Admission Lottery.** Each epoch, agents commit sha256(seed||nonce) to a kernel-hosted delay vault before the network beacon is revealed; admission slots are drawn by ranking hashes against the next beacon value. Because the attacker cannot precompute the beacon, identities must be reserved and revealed after the seed, forfeiting a fixed anti-rush deposit per address. To forge many identities, the attacker must post that deposit for every address, then absorb the cost of unused losing slots.
